jobs.location: REMOTE (US), Full-time, https://helmsted.ai/careers Helmsted is the AI-native operating system for wealth advisors of complex households: planning, tax and estate analysis, meetings and the client portal, run by agents that do the work. You'd build the agents and the intelligence behind them with our CTO: evals and systems that improve from their own usage, long-term memory, retrieval over millions of documents, model routing and cost, and secure, permissioned access to client data. Fintech experience is a plus, not a requirement. Remote in the US today, with eventual relocation as the team centralizes. Paid sick leave; health insurance and 401(k) under discussion. Applications accepted on an ongoing basis. To apply, email careers@helmsted.ai with a resume and short answers to the questions in the full JD: https://helmsted.ai/careers/helmsted-founding-ai-engineer.pd...
